description: This file defines the RowColumnInformation class with static methods for calculating row and column information in spreadsheet cells, including functions like COLUMN, COLUMNS, ROW, and ROWS.

classes.name: RowColumnInformation
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve row and column information from cell references in spreadsheets.

methods.name: cellAddressNullOrWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if the cell address is null or a whitespace string.

methods.name: cellColumn
methods.description: Returns the column index of a given Cell object.

methods.name: COLUMN
methods.description: Returns the column number(s) of a cell reference or range.

methods.name: COLUMNS
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a range or array.

methods.name: cellRow
methods.description: Returns the row index of a given Cell object.

methods.name: ROW
methods.description: Returns the row number(s) of a cell reference or range.

methods.name: ROWS
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a range or array.
